floater.name: wolf_dj_playlist
floater.title: Wolf DJ Playlist

button.label: Music
button.name: music_dir
button.tool_tip: Your Music folder.

button.label: Home
button.name: home_dir
button.tool_tip: Your home folder.

button.label: Up
button.name: up_dir
button.tool_tip: The folder above this one.

scroll_list.name: browser
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click a folder to open it, or a song to add it to the playlist.

button.label: Add
button.name: add_files
button.tool_tip: Add the selected songs to the playlist.

button.label: Add folder
button.name: add_folder
button.tool_tip: Add every song in this folder to the playlist.

combo_box.name: playlist_select
combo_box.tool_tip: The playlist the player plays. Switching while a song plays lets that song finish, then plays the new playlist from its first song.

button.label: Delete
button.name: playlist_delete
button.tool_tip: Delete this playlist (only the list - your music files are not touched).

button.label: New
button.name: playlist_new
button.tool_tip: Start a new, empty playlist with the name typed on the left.

button.label: Rename
button.name: playlist_rename
button.tool_tip: Give this playlist the name typed on the left.

button.name: prev
button.tool_tip: Previous song (or back to the start of this one).

button.label: Play
button.name: play
button.tool_tip: Play / pause.

button.name: next
button.tool_tip: Next song.

scroll_list.name: playlist
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click a song to play it.

button.label: Up
button.name: move_up
button.tool_tip: Move the selected song up.

button.label: Down
button.name: move_down
button.tool_tip: Move the selected song down.

check_box.label: Send each song's title to the stream
check_box.name: send_titles

floater.text: It plays on whichever music channel has "Wolf DJ playlist" as its source (Play puts it on a free one). To hear it yourself, turn on that channel's MON on the desk.

button.name: set_jingle_0
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 1 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_1
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 2 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_2
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 3 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_3
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 4 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_4
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 5 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_5
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 6 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_6
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 7 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

button.name: set_jingle_7
button.tool_tip: Put the selected song on jingle pad 8 (it plays from the pads in the mixer). Pick another song to replace it.

floater.text: Pick a song, then press a pad to put it there.

check_box.label: Enable Chat Control
check_box.name: chat_control
check_box.tool_tip: Let you, and objects you own, run the playlist with chat commands on the channel on the right.

spinner.label: Command channel
spinner.name: chat_channel
spinner.tool_tip: Type /channel play (or pause, stop ...) in nearby chat. Your own scripts send the same line with llOwnerSay.
